snippet.title: Block 17 | Horror pixelart game | First Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Block17 — a grim 2D pixel art shooter with horror and survival elements.
Dive into a dark sci-fi world filled with terror, monsters, and torn flesh fused with steel.
This teaser gives you a first glimpse of what the player must face in a brutal fight for survival.
Subscribe for gameplay, trailers, and release updates — and don’t forget to wishlist Block17 on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3083210/Block_17/
Follow us on Steam!
